name: raycast
title: world.raycast
lead: The first block a ray from `from` along `direction` meets within `max` blocks, and the face it came in through; nil for none.
signature: world.raycast(from: Vec3, direction: Vec3, max: number ?) → RayHit ?

usedIn.quote: world.raycast(from, direction, 32)   -- the first block a ray meets within 32 blocks, or nil:
world.raycast(player.at + vec3(0, 1.62, 0), player:look())   -- what the player is looking at
